_comment: Extension to the canonical ContosoInspections schema (episode 12). Only NEW columns live here; the base tables are never redefined.

solution.description: AI triage columns for inspection items. Depends on ContosoInspections.

columns.description: Severity suggested by the model. A person decides; this never replaces Severity.
Which route produced the suggestion: aibuilder, foundry or claude.
The model's own 0 to 100 confidence. Not a calibrated probability.
Model-written summary of the item, at most 240 characters in practice.
True once a person accepted the suggestion.
